item.title: Leinster SFC draw: Brennan's Dublin on course to meet Louth
item.description: Leinster champions Louth could meet their old manager Ger Brennan should their progress to the provincial semi-finals.

item.title: O'Shea extends North Melbourne stay ahead of AFLW Grand Final
item.description: Erika O'Shea has signed a one-year contract extension with the North Melbourne Kangaroos ahead of tomorrow's AFLW Grand Final against the Brisbane Lions.

item.title: Tipp put Ryan forward for GAA presidency
item.description: Tipperary GAA have nominated Ger Ryan to run for GAA president at Congress next February.

item.title: TEG unveiled as new Westmeath GAA sponsor
item.description: Local firm TEG is the new main sponsor of Westmeath GAA.

item.title: Jim Gavin to attend Tyrone GAA business event
item.description: Jim Gavin will attend a business event supported by Tyrone GAA in Garvaghey today.

item.title: Derrygonnelly awarded Fermanagh SFL title after CCC U-turn
item.description: Derrygonnelly Harps have been awarded the Fermanagh SFL title after the county's CCC reversed a previous decision to order a replay of last August's final against Erne Gaels.

item.title: Coyne named Mayo football captain
item.description: Jack Coyne has been appointed Mayo senior football captain for 2026.

item.title: GAA on TV: provincial final action takes centre stage
item.description: The Ulster and Munster club SHC finals along with the Connacht club SFC final will be shown live on TV this weekend.

item.title: Niamh McIntosh on captaining Moneyglass to a first Ulster title and, honoring her mother
item.description: Considering how strongly connected her family is to the club, Niamh McIntosh has felt privileged to be captain of St Ergnat's Moneyglass for their successful 2025 championship campaign.
